proof:
have key : ∀ (l : List α) (idx : Nat), idx < l.length → l.Perm (l[idx] :: l.eraseIdx idx) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro idx h; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero idx)
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    intro idx h
    cases idx with
    | zero => exact List.Perm.refl _
    | succ idx' =>
      have h' : idx' < tl.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h
      have hIH := IH idx' h'
      have hstep : (hd :: tl).Perm (hd :: tl[idx'] :: tl.eraseIdx idx') := hIH.cons hd
      have hswap : (hd :: tl[idx'] :: tl.eraseIdx idx').Perm (tl[idx'] :: hd :: tl.eraseIdx idx') :=
        List.Perm.swap tl[idx'] hd (tl.eraseIdx idx')
      exact hstep.trans hswap
have h1 : l1.Perm (l1[idx1] :: l1.eraseIdx idx1) := key l1 idx1 hidx1
have h2 : l2.Perm (l2[idx2] :: l2.eraseIdx idx2) := key l2 idx2 hidx2
have h3 : (l1[idx1] :: l1.eraseIdx idx1).Perm (l2[idx2] :: l2.eraseIdx idx2) :=
  h1.symm.trans (hperm.trans h2)
rw [heq] at h3
exact h3.cons_inv
